Loop gain is far too low (T≈1.6, from a1 = 0.62 × ideal), and the bandwidth suggests the load cap dominates. Next step: raise loop gain and gm. That means a longer-L, higher gm/Id input pair at maximum tail current, a lower-gds PMOS load, and a smaller R1 so the feedback-node pole stays high. The ratio is pre-compensated for the finite loop gain. Predictions now use `spec["cl"]`, so model-vs-sim mismatch will show up.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),
    "L_in":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),
    "gmid_ld": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (72e-6, 40e-6, 74e-6),
    "R1":      (40e3, 15e3, 120e3),
    "ratio":   (0.124, 0.110, 0.135),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.3e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; Ih = It / 2.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.55, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=0.9)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=0.3)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["ratio"] * R1

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "xd", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf)
    A = m1.gm / gout
    T = A * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * T / (1.0 + T)
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m1.cgd
    bw = (gout + beta * m1.gm) / (2 * PI * cout)
    fnode = 1.0 / (2 * PI * (R1 * Rf / (R1 + Rf)) * (m1.cgg + 5e-15))
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    bw = 1.0 / (1.0 / bw + 0.5 / fnode + 0.3 / fmir)
    vnat = vdd - m3.vgs
    offset = (vnat - 0.9) / A * (1.0 + Rf / R1)
    power = 1.98 * (It + iref)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": offset, "power": power}
```
